addition.item: Added the changelogurl tag to the extension manifest XML so the extension version links to the changelog in the manage view.
Added Joomla! topics to the repository and tightened the description.

change.item: Removed the author URL from the manifest.
Updated the update server file to remove Joomla 4 and add Joomla 6.
Removed the plg_content_ prefix from the element value in the update server file for proper update detection because Joomla! updates require only the plugin element name without the prefix.
Declared $loadYoutube and $loadVimeo as class properties instead of local variables.
Removed the $autoloadlanguage class variable since language strings are not needed in the plugin.
Replaced the generic Joomla! Event with a concrete ContentPrepareEvent.
Replaced calls to $event->getArguments() with individual getter method calls.
Updated the scriptfile to remove Joomla 4 support and update the minimum PHP version.
Replaced the enqueueMessage() call in the catch block with error logging.
Retrieved the document via the application injected through CMSPlugin instead of through Factory.
Replaced the while + strpos + substr_replace loop with preg_replace_callback() and a dedicated callback method.
Updated both lite-yt-embed.css and lite-yt-embed.js to the latest GitHub versions.
Replaced Chris W Thomson’s Lite Vimeo Embed implementation with lite-vimeo-embed2 by dldevinc.

addition.item: Added functionality to strip HTML from shortcodes.

change.item: Optimized context checking logic by using a switch statement.
Tightened the description language strings in both English and French.

fix.item: Fixed the manifest file to properly include version information.

Plugin now ignores shortcode content containing HTML characters, specifically 
<
.
Fixed version information inside the update file and installer script.
Corrected the name of the binary file.
Added regex validation checks for YouTube URLs.

addition.item: Initial release of the LiteVidEmbed plugin.
